operating_notes.text: Nibe Space Private Limited received a ₹12.58 Cr (inclusive of all taxes and duties) Letter of Award from MSEDCL for GIS-based survey, mapping and digital data preparation of its distribution network, to be executed in tranches within 42 mon
During Q4FY26, ₹23.11 Cr of preferential issue proceeds were utilized for working capital paid entirely to Finolex J-Power Systems Ltd.
Nibe Limited successfully test fired its SURYASTRA Universal Rocket Launcher System at ITR, Chandipur, achieving a CEP of 1.5 meters for the 150 Km range and 2 meters for the 300 Km range.
Vayu Astra-1 Loitering Munition successfully completed technical trials at Pokhran and Joshimath.
Shirdi Defence Manufacturing Complex inaugurated with capacity for 5 lakh 155mm ammunition shells annually.
FY26 cash from operations was -₹34.52 Cr against capex of ₹112.54 Cr, with financing inflow of ₹127.04 Cr.
Trade receivables of ₹231.36 Cr at 31 March 2026 equal 48.8% of FY26 revenue of ₹474.45 Cr.

Preferential allotment of ₹104.48 Cr on 5 March 2026: ₹75 Cr used to repay borrowings, ₹23.11 Cr for working capital, ₹12.69 Cr for new facilities unutilised; ₹6.37 Cr remained unutilised at 31 March 2026.
Subsidiary Nibe Defence and Aerospace Limited granted lifetime DPIIT license for manufacturing and proof-testing of firearms and ammunition.

timeline.summary: Ganesh Ramesh Nibe, as Promoter and Promoter Group, confirmed no encumbrances on Nibe shares by March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Nibe subsidiary Nibe Space received a ₹12.58 Cr LOA from MSEDCL for GIS survey and network mapping.
Nibe filed the monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹98.11 Cr utilized out of ₹251.85 Cr preferential issue proceeds.
In May 2026, Nibe Limited announced the successful test firing of its SURYASTRA Universal Rocket Launcher System at ITR Chandipur, achieving high precision across 150 km and 300 km ranges.
Nibe Limited successfully completed technical trials of its Vayu Astra-1 Loitering Munition at Pokhran and Joshimath.
NIBE Group inaugurated its Shirdi Defence Manufacturing Complex on May 23, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹259.5 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹29.23 Cr.
Nibe Defence and Aerospace subsidiary received a lifetime DPIIT license for manufacturing and proof testing of firearms and ammunition.
NIBE allotted 320,000 equity shares at ₹1,258 per share on June 8, 2026, pursuant to warrant conversion.
